sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 is a state-of-the-art native multi-modal model capable of generating 2K AI video with synchronized 3D stereo audio in a single inference pass README.md 3 Architecture Overview The MiniMax H3 architecture deviates from traditional video-only models by employing a joint diffusion process.
